candidates.quote: Quarry Row Homes LP has asked the City to freeze the taxable value of the former quarry parcel for ten years.
Eighteen of the ninety apartments would be reserved for lower-income renters.
Households earning no more than sixty percent of area median income would qualify.
candidates.wording: earning no more than sixty percent of area median income

candidates.quote: Rent plus utilities would be capped at thirty percent of the qualifying income.

candidates.quote: The restrictions would run through December 31, 2055.
